test_cases.name: null_attribute_error
test_cases.input: My Python script crashes with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'id'. How do I debug this?
assertions: Suggests printing the value before the error

test_cases.name: flaky_test
test_cases.input: A test passes locally but fails intermittently in CI. Help me find the root cause.
assertions: Mentions race conditions or environment differences
Suggests adding logging and reducing concurrency

test_cases.name: performance_regression
test_cases.input: The API endpoint suddenly became 5x slower after the last deploy. Debug it systematically.
assertions: Suggests checking git history and recent changes
Advises verifying with measurements before and after the fix
